items.performers: London Symphony Orchestra; Sir Antonio Pappano
items.label: LSO Live
items.note: The score is inscribed “Dedicated without permission to Jean Sibelius”. Pappano and the London Symphony Orchestra pair the Fifth, which the label describes as reaching for hope amid the turmoil of war, with the Ninth Symphony on LSO0900. The orchestra’s own channel carries the slow movement, the Romanza.

items.work: A Pastoral Symphony (No. 3) and Symphony No. 4
items.label: Hyperion
items.note: The war-haunted Pastoral, with its natural-trumpet fanfare in the second movement, sits beside the grinding semitones of the Fourth. Hyperion’s page for CDA68280 carries Robert Matthew-Walker’s booklet note and the label’s listing of both symphonies.

items.work: The Lark Ascending — violin and piano
items.performers: Julia Hwang, violin; Charles Matthews, piano
items.label: Signum Classics
items.note: The violin-and-piano version that Marie Hall and Geoffrey Mendham gave at Shirehampton on 15 December 1920 appears on Hwang’s debut album Subito (SIGCD486). Hyperion’s page for the release reproduces Richard Bratby’s booklet note on the piece.
